stories.title: Powerful Colombia quake kills at least 111, trapping dozens under collapsed buildings
stories.summary: A magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck Colombia toppling buildings and trapping people. Several dozen were reported dead.

stories.title: Why Russia and Ukraine can't stop each other's air attacks
stories.summary: Russia and Ukraine are both striking farther into each other's territory, and neither side has a good way to stop the attacks. With no quick fix, the winter ahead could be especially hard.

stories.title: Trump and RFK Jr. try again to upend vaccines for kids
stories.summary: President Trump signed an executive order on Monday about vaccines, saying children should get fewer. His administration has been blocked in the courts from changing the vaccine schedule.

stories.title: Rafting brings people with different politics together
stories.summary: A whitewater rafting group brings people of different political persuasions together to talk and paddle.

stories.title: Who really needs testosterone?
stories.summary: The military plans to start screening service members for low testosterone, and social media is overflowing with over-the-top claims about low-T. But who actually needs testosterone therapy?

stories.title: Revisiting the 'Mother Road,' Route 66, which turns 100 this year
stories.summary: This year marks the 100th anniversary of the legendary U.S. Route 66. We revisit a 1984 documentary made as the last stretch of the highway was being bypassed by the Federal Interstate System.
